6914.name: Lizardman
6914.review_notes: Exact level-53 profile: Defence 43, Magic 1, melee defence -20/25/0 and light/standard/heavy ranged defence -10/0/0; no elemental weakness. Ordinary direct attacks use these defence rolls; poison immunity does not change direct-hit damage.
limitations: Ordinary direct attacks only; Poison and venom damage are not included (this NPC is immune).
Incoming poisonous attacks, survival, movement, Slayer bonuses and time fighting Shayzien soldiers are not simulated.
This review applies only to the Level 53 Lizardman profile; brutes, shamans and other levels require separate review.
